reasoning: This trial appears to have been terminated early with only 2 patients enrolled out of what was likely a much larger planned sample size. With no reported results for the primary endpoint (6-month progression-free survival rate), no effect size, no p-value, and no biomarker data, there is insufficient enrollment and follow-up to evaluate any aspect of the mechanistic causal chain. The combination therapy involves multiple components (SBRT radiation to liver, PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor atezolizumab, and chemotherapy with carboplatin/etoposide) targeting both local liver metastases and systemic immune activation, but with only 2 patients, no meaningful assessment of target engagement, pathway modulation, or clinical translation is possible.

failure_modes.evidence: Only 2 patients enrolled, no primary endpoint results reported, no biomarker data, no target engagement evidence, suggesting early termination before meaningful data collection
Sample size of 2 patients is far below what would be needed for any statistical analysis of a 6-month progression-free survival endpoint
